source.name: Washington Wizards (nba.com)
source.quote: The Washington Wizards today announced that Robinhood, a financial services platform that pioneered commission-free stock trading, becomes the NBA franchise’s official brokerage and jersey patch partner.
source.note: The club announced the patch on 23 October 2023 for the 2023-24 season; the release does not restate the 2026-27 season.
